description: Implementation of CustomerAttributeDao interface for accessing CustomerAttribute data, including methods for retrieving customer attributes by various identifiers, using QueryDSL and JPA.

classes.name: CustomerAttributeDaoImpl
classes.description: DAO implementation class for CustomerAttribute entity, providing methods to fetch customer attributes based on various criteria.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a CustomerAttribute by its ID, fetching associated customer, options, and descriptions.

methods.name: getByOptionId
methods.description: Retrieves a CustomerAttribute by merchant store, customer ID, and attribute ID, including related entities.

methods.name: getByCustomerId
methods.description: Retrieves a list of CustomerAttributes for a specific customer within a merchant store.

methods.name: getByOptionValueId
methods.description: Retrieves CustomerAttributes associated with a specific option value ID within a merchant store.

methods.name: getByOptionId
methods.description: Retrieves CustomerAttributes by merchant store and option ID.
